newsitem.title: USA: AMEX July short interest rose by 1.18 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: AMEX July short interest rose by 1.18 mln shares.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said on Monday that short interest for the month rose 1.18 million shares to a record 172.42 million shares as of the July 15 settlement data.
The exchange said a previous short interest record of 171.24 million shares was reported in mid-June.
In the year-ago period, short interest totaled 124.35 million shares, the exchange said.
